subject: AI Leaders Dinner - 29 May - Aerlume Seattle
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about what you're building at [COMPANY] so I wanted to reach
out with an invite. Our founder [SENDER] is hosting an intimate dinner for AI
leaders in Seattle on Thursday May 29th. We'd love for you to join and
connect you to other folks tackling problems in autonomous systems

We've reserved a private dining room for 30 guests at Aerlume from 6:30 to
9:30 pm. Attendees include Executives & Heads of AI from Latitude AI, Brinc
Drones, Carbon Robotics, etc.

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we're a data development platform
built to help teams accelerate their model development. We work with over
200 AI teams including Woven by Toyota, Wayve and Lucid Motors.

Happy to share more details if you're interested in joining?

subject: Working w/ Toyota & GE | Hi from [SENDER] @ Encord
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I lead a manufacturing & industrial applications team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we're working with a few of your peers (Toyota, Bosch, Siemens, Honeywell, General Electric, etc) to expand into new AI/Computer Vision products & scale use cases like Automated Surface Inspection Systems (ASIS), new material discovery, predictive maintenance, quality control, worker safety, etc. 

I've been following ArcelorMittal's Global R&D and Downstream Solutions work for some time, so keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: [Invitation] Dîner Leaders IA à Paris 21 Mai
text:
Bonjour [NAME]​, 

Notre co-fondateur organise un dîner intime avec des clients et des leaders de l'IA à Paris, et nous serions ravis de vous y inviter.

Les participants sont des CEO, CTO, Directeurs de Computer Vision et VP IA de start-ups comme Jellysmack, ProovStation, Veesion, etc. Ce dîner privé aura lieu le 21 mai au restaurant Maison de l'Amérique Latine, où nous avons réservé un salon privatisé pour environ 20 personnes, à partir de 19h.

Si vous ne connaissez pas encore Encord, nous avons levé 50M$ auprès de CRV et Y Combinator. Nous proposons une plateforme de développement de données end-to-end pour les équipes ML/IA, utilisée notamment par Axa, EuroControl, Moon Surgical, etc. Nous unifions la gestion des données, leur visualisation et leur annotation au sein d'une seule et même solution.

Merci de bien vouloir confirmer votre présence à cette invitation si vous souhaitez réserver votre place - les places sont limitées et attribuées selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi.
